narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal`: tax is computed on `cents` instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green.** 625 total, 625 passing.

`orderTotal` in `[src/pricing.js:39-43](src/pricing.js:39)` taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount. Fixed to tax `discounted` instead of `cents`. All 3 `order totals` failures cleared, nothing else was broken.
